description: This file defines the CartViewModel class in Kotlin, which manages the UI state and interactions for a shopping cart in an Android application. It utilizes Android Architecture Components like ViewModel and StateFlow, connecting to a repository for data operations, and exposes observable properties such as cart items, totals, coupons, and grouped rows for rendering the UI.

classes.name: CartViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class for managing shopping cart data and UI state in an Android application, exposing reactive streams for UI binding and user interactions.

classes.name: CartRow
classes.description: Sealed class representing a row in a sectioned RecyclerView, with subclasses for category headers and cart items.

methods.name: ensureCartLoaded
methods.description: Ensures the backend cart data has been fetched at least once for the current user context.

methods.name: setActiveEmail
methods.description: Sets or clears the email (user identity) associated with the cart for backend operations.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes a product from the cart by its ID.

methods.name: updateQty
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a product in the cart; if quantity is zero or less, the item is removed.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.

methods.name: applyCoupon
methods.description: Applies a coupon code to the cart, with optimistic update and backend validation.

methods.name: removeCoupon
methods.description: Removes the currently applied coupon from the cart.
